messages:
infra-bot: [ALERT] Incident detected: autoscaler failing to provision GPUs in us-central1, queue size growing for inference-prod. Error rate spike 5xx -> 12%. Pager: @mike_oncall @elaine_oncall
mike_oncall: got the page, looking. Checking autoscaler logs now.
sarah_infra: seeing repeated API errors in autoscaler: "quotaExceeded" when creating instances with accelerator type nvidia-tesla-a100. sample: `ERROR 403: Quota 'GPUS' exceeded for project 123456`.
raj_eng: can you paste the exact zone? us-central1-a? we need to see if it's regional quota or per-zone.
sarah_infra: us-central1-a and -b both returning quotaExceeded on attempts to create node pools. Autoscaler attempted 8 times in the last 5m.
mike_oncall: customer impact? which routes are affected?
jamie_support: Observability: the affected route is /v1/generate with model-redwood-xl dedicated pool. High-priority customers on dedicated capacity might experience slow/no-start generation. Support ticket count: 6 incoming, some on SLO degradation.
elaine_oncall: flagging P1, paging infra-engineering. @raj_eng are we able to failover traffic to us-east1?
raj_eng: yes, we can shift routing policy but need to ensure model variant and capacity there. us-east1 has warm capacity for smaller model; large model only on demand. We can route low-latency traffic to a smaller quantized variant for 30m.
mike_oncall: ok, plan: 1) initiate cross-region route failover for non-enterprise customers, 2) move noncritical batch jobs out of GPU queue, 3) open cloud support case + request quota increase, 4) prepare handoff to Elaine at 16:30 UTC.
sarah_infra: attempting manual node create to confirm: `gcloud compute instances create gpu-test --zone=us-central1-a --accelerator='type=nvidia-a100,count=1'` -> response: `ERROR: (gcloud.compute.instances.create) Quota 'GPUS' exceeded. Contact support.`
raj_eng: I can flip routing to send 60% traffic to us-east1 quantized model: executing rollout now.
raj_eng: `console: update-route inference-prod default -> us-east1 (fallback-quantized-v2) 60%` :rolling_out:
mike_oncall: routing update accepted. Monitoring latency/5xx.
incident-bot: Incident status: Mitigating — traffic reroute live, autoscaler still failing in us-central1, support case created (CASE-987654).
jamie_support: Notified top 3 impacted customers via status page and direct email. Triage notes attached.
sarah_infra: GCP case response: initial auto-reply. live agent assigned ASG-231. They asked for quota usage screenshot and project ID.
mike_oncall: attaching usage screenshot to case. Also requested temporary quota bump for GPUs in us-central1 while we stabilize.
elaine_oncall: can we free any GPUs by killing lower-priority experiments? In prod we have a few dev jobs stuck in queue.
raj_eng: identified 2 long-running dev experiments in k8s-ns=dev-ml, evicting pods now: `kubectl delete pod ml-train-.* -n dev-ml`.
raj_eng: pods evicted, freed 4 GPUs. Autoscaler tried creating again but still quotaExceeded on subsequent attempts — suggests regional quota fully consumed, not just ours.
sarah_infra: GCP agent says regional pool is exhausted for that project and recommends quota increase or using different accelerators. Also suggests using preemptible GPUs (if available) but riskier.
mike_oncall: short-term: keep reroute active, continue evictions, pause scheduled batch jobs, and update customers. Long-term: request permanent quota increase and multi-region warm pools.
jamie_support: Drafting status update: "We are mitigating by routing traffic to an alternative region and model. Impact: degraded performance for some customers; no data loss. More updates in 30m." :pencil:
elaine_oncall: FYI — marketing sent a ping asking for public status wording. Use the drafted note above.
raj_eng: added a temporary fallback to CPU-based small model for non-interactive requests: `transport.policy: fallbacks: [cpu-small-v1]` — will reduce throughput but avoids total failure.
mike_oncall: great. any ETA from GCP?
sarah_infra: GCP agent: case ASG-231 escalated to quota team, ETA 2-4 hours for review, possible immediate temporary bump depending on inventory.
incident-bot: Reminder: Handoff scheduled at 16:30 UTC. Next oncall: @elaine_oncall.
mike_oncall: handing off to Elaine. Summary: autoscaler failing to create GPUs in us-central1 due to project/regional GPU quota exhaustion; traffic rerouted to us-east1 quantized model 60%; dev batch jobs evicted freeing 4 GPUs but insufficient; GCP case opened CASE-987654/ASG-231; customer communication sent. Monitor queues and 5xx.
elaine_oncall: taking over. I'll continue to coordinate with GCP and adjust routing as needed. If quota not restored in 2 hours, prepare plan to shift enterprise customers to Dedicated reserved capacity in other regions and open internal exec alert.
jamie_support: noted, will continue customer comms and update status page.
gcp-support-bot: CASE-987654 update: quota team acknowledged. Requesting projected usage window and list of instance templates. ETA 3 hours.
elaine_oncall: thanks, continuing watch. will post next update in 20m or on any major change. :white_check_mark:
